product_one_liner.value: CompanyCam helps contractors document jobs with photos, communicate with crews, and share project progress with customers.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes a contractor-focused jobsite productivity platform for documentation, crew communication, and sharing progress with clients: https://companycam.com/press.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page displays a Core plan, user limits, and additional-user pricing: https://companycam.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: CompanyCam publishes customer case studies for McComb Window & Door and Best Roofing, including a usage testimonial and an explicit account of implementation. Sources: https://companycam.com/resources/case-studies/mccomb-window-door and https://companycam.com/case-studies/best-roofing. | named_customers.0: The McComb Window & Door case study names the business and includes its testimonial about using CompanyCam. | named_customers.1: The case study explicitly states that Best Roofing rolled out CompanyCam in 2022.

employee_band.notes: CompanyCam’s LinkedIn company profile explicitly lists its company size as 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/companycam.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: CompanyCam’s LinkedIn company page explicitly identifies its headquarters as Lincoln, Nebraska: https://linkedin.com/company/companycam. | hq_country: The company record identifies Lincoln, United States, consistent with the headquarters location on CompanyCam’s LinkedIn page: https://linkedin.com/company/companycam.

founded_year.notes: CompanyCam’s press page states that it was founded in 2015: https://companycam.com/press.

eng_blog.notes: Two CompanyCam engineering articles by Chad Wilken explain implementation work: request-ID propagation through Sidekiq middleware and asynchronous Elasticsearch reindexing for the product’s project feed. Sources: https://dev.to/companycam/sidekiq-request-id-tracking-2cdm and https://dev.to/companycam/building-a-workflow-for-async-searchkick-reindexing-4mk8.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal contains multiple documentation resources, including API Reference, partnering guidance, Developer Accounts, and Core API documentation: https://developers.companycam.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists ten openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. The marketing analyst and GTM systems roles do not qualify under the specified rules: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/companycam.

model_provider.notes: A CompanyCam backend engineer’s public portfolio explicitly says the product shipped using Anthropic, OpenAI, and Groq. This is a firsthand engineering disclosure rather than an official company provider list: https://austn.net/work/companycam.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification and GDPR compliance. Of the five requested categories, these two are named: https://companycam.com/trust-center. | compliance_certs.0: The trust page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification. | compliance_certs.1: The trust page explicitly claims GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: CompanyCam’s financing announcement identifies the round as Series C, and the funding history records it as the latest round: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/companycam-secures-strategic-growth-investment-from-b-capital-302535365.html. | funding_date: The transaction advisor states that the Series C closed in August 2025, yielding 2025-08: https://www.williamblair.com/News/CompanyCam-and-B-Capital-Transaction. | funding_amount_usd: The transaction advisor explicitly labels the Series C amount as not disclosed, so no USD amount can be reported: https://www.williamblair.com/News/CompanyCam-and-B-Capital-Transaction.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series C closed in August 2025, within the eighteen months preceding November 9, 2026: https://www.williamblair.com/News/CompanyCam-and-B-Capital-Transaction.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Inside Sales Representative posting includes an application link and describes lead engagement, tailored demos, and sales activity. This qualifies as a sales-representative opening: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/companycam/f06dd43d-f2d7-41e9-b064-3c004f29f703.

launched_6mo.notes: A September 8, 2026 announcement introduced creating and editing Documents and reports through the API and MCP, previously limited to reading them. This is a substantive feature launch within the requested six-month window: https://intercom.news/companycam/156729-more-of-your-companycam-data-is-now-open-to-the-tools-you-already-use.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Saliq Hussaini’s profile dates his CompanyCam VP, Embedded Finance & Payments role to July 2026, following his Beam role. This falls within the requested twelve-month window: https://linkedin.com/in/saliqhussaini.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The GTM Systems Developer posting explicitly describes building workflows across Salesforce and the company’s broader GTM stack: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/companycam/b6335f3d-853d-4e66-823f-2e09489738a1. | crm_stack_signal.0: The company’s job posting explicitly names Salesforce as part of its operational GTM stack.
